$comment: Force-based. The solver already reports contact force (physics.getContacts .maxForce, newtons), so damage is a RATE over the excess above a floor rather than an energy derived from velocities — deriving energy would duplicate what the solver computed. damage = max(0, maxForce - damageFloorN) * damageScaleHpPerNs * weaponFactor * (1 - armorReduction) * dt
